verification: source-verified from local assembly; not live-game verified

entries.trigger: Compute numRaccoonBabies as TimesFedRaccoons - 1, temporarily subtract one until seven days after DaysPlayedWhenLastRaccoonBundleWasFinished, clamp at zero, and award when the result is at least 8.
entries.action: Finish generated raccoon requests and allow the final seven-day reveal delay to expire, then load/reset the Forest shared state.

entries.trigger: The location reset calls getAchievement(36) unconditionally for the entering player.
entries.action: Unlock the theater route, obtain a ticket, and enter MovieTheater for a screening.
entries.evidence: Durable Farmer.achievements token 36; current MovieTheater location is transient supporting evidence

entries.trigger: After judging, speaking to the festival host awards the achievement when grangeScore is at least 90.
entries.action: Submit nine eligible display items, complete judging with score >= 90, then speak to Lewis for the result.
entries.evidence: Event.grangeJudged and Event.grangeScore during festival; durable Farmer.achievements token 37

entries.trigger: The evaluated Governor reaction index must equal 4; that branch calls getAchievement(38). Multiplayer also requires enough team contributions unless the precomputed reaction is 6.
entries.action: Contribute an eligible ingredient whose evaluated quality/edibility result produces reaction 4, then start the soup tasting.
entries.evidence: Computed event reaction index during Luau; durable Farmer.achievements token 38

entries.trigger: IslandSouth local-state reset calls getAchievement(40) unconditionally; first entry also queues Visited_Island mail.
entries.action: Repair Willy's boat, buy passage, and enter IslandSouth.
entries.evidence: Durable Farmer.achievements token 40; hasOrWillReceiveMail(Visited_Island) is supporting arrival history

entries.trigger: Effective completion percent (percentGameComplete plus 1% per waiver) must reach 100% so the overnight update sets team.farmPerfect; entering Summit then awards token 44 only when farmPerfect is true.
entries.action: Complete or waive remaining perfection components, sleep through the farm-perfect update, unlock Summit access, and enter Summit.
entries.evidence: Utility.percentGameComplete, NetWorldState.PerfectionWaivers, FarmerTeam.farmPerfect; durable Farmer.achievements token 44
